notes: Four keys appear to split this person; review-only identifications are probable, as explained above. The list covers 219 article/chapter/essay entries, 44 additional encyclopedia/journalism items, 25 electronic items, 26 primary books plus four explicitly identified editions, and one edited journal issue. The duplicated 2025 Great Acceleration encyclopedia entry is counted once; the same-DOI 2022/2023 prospective-Anthropocene listings are retained with their CV years. Incidental translation/reprint notes are grouped with their main entries. The 2027 Webs edition is scheduled, not published. CV years are retained: Environmental History As If Nature Existed is 2010 versus graph 2009; the Introductory Reader is 2012 versus 2013; From Chimps to Bats is 2022 versus 2021. The Agriculture, Forests, and Ecological History title ends in 1983 in the CV versus graph 1984. Graph w-2357, w-2358 and w-2416 truncate titles; w-3550 has a frontmatter label. Edited-book roles are missing from generic graph book kinds. About 150 book reviews are reported only by venue, so their individual titles cannot be reconstructed. The podcast title is inferred from its CV URL; the Five Books entry was updated in June 2026. Students use graph expansions of matching CV initials; six additional doctoral advisees are missing. Unnamed committees, outside examining, grants, presentations, teaching and service are excluded.
